notes:
Based on what I found on Cartwheels Gym Centre's own site (the "Cartwheel Gym" in Halton Hills), here's what applies to a toddler for the fall term:


This class is for our youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver, focusing on sensory and gross motor development, co-ordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun.
 
The 1-year old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins.
 This is their Tiny Gym program — the one where a parent participates alongside the toddler, distinct from Mini Gym which drops the parent once a child is ready.

On fall specifics: 
availability and pricing are available by logging into their Registration Website
, and 
pricing information is not on the main site because terms vary in length over the season, causing pricing to fluctuate term by term.
 No fall day/time has been posted publicly.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Tiny Gym, Cartwheels Gym Centre",
      "age_fit": "youngest gymnasts (around 1 year+) with a parent/caregiver participating; independent walking recommended",
      "source_name": "Cartwheels Gym Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

I left out `when` and `price` because their own program page says that detail sits behind their registration login rather than being posted openly — I didn't want to guess a day, time, or fee they haven't published.
